integrity: Analytic proof supplied. A standalone standard-library checker supplements but does not replace the proof. No independent audit or certification performed.
scientific_limitations: Only complex Hilbert dimension two with a repeated real eigenvalue approaching one; the quantity is the power-difference Ritt functional rather than the resolvent constant. The full manuscript of a closely related 2026 preprint could not be inspected; publication priority is provisional.
title: Sharp near-identity Ritt power defects for two-dimensional contractions
